gates.label: Trigger Lab
gates.review_action: Run model-executed routing on blind and adversarial holdouts before claiming real routing accuracy.

gates.label: Output Lab
gates.review_action: Retain deterministic checks separately from model output quality; development rerun 2/2 and locked holdout 1/3 do not establish reliable autonomous execution.

gates.label: Runtime Matrix
gates.review_action: Generate and run packaged adapters on each target platform before external distribution.

gates.label: Trust Report
gates.review_action: Keep report dependencies pinned, pin remaining suite dependencies, and retain the documented invoice command-line warnings before broader distribution.

gates.label: Runtime Permission Probes
gates.review_action: Run packaged adapter permission probes after a distribution package exists.

gates.label: Skill Atlas
gates.review_action: Add model-executed collision and stale-skill evidence before claiming a complete route atlas.

gates.label: Operations Loop
gates.review_action: Add adoption and drift reporting only after real team usage data exists; do not fabricate telemetry.
